svg.aria-label: Globe wireframe — true 3D spin around body Y
svg.text: Globe wireframe — true 3D spin around body Y
✓ Expected: Wireframe globe rotates around its (tilted) polar axis. Meridians sweep past; the polar regions stay fixed. Real 3D motion, not a 2D group rotation.
✗ If broken: Parallels visibly move with the rotation (= it's actually a Z-axis spin, not Y).
